---
title: DOCX cell probe
format: hebstr-doc-docx
---

A `gt` table inside a cross-referenced float, the one shape that leaves a table
cell open: knitr prints the table as a raw `{=openxml}` block ending on
`</w:tbl>`, and Quarto wraps the float in a one-cell table to keep caption and
content together.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: "A gt table in a referenced float."
#| echo: false

gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:3], 3))
```

Reference: @tbl-gt.
